Definition: Citing unnamed experts — 'studies show,' 'scholars agree' — with no one named and no finding cited. Anonymity makes the authority impossible to check.
Example: Someone argues, 'Studies show this works,' without naming any study.
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone argues, 'Scholars agree the Gospels were written centuries later,' without naming any scholar.
HowToRespond: Ask for names: 'Which experts, and what did they actually conclude?'
